blocks.text: Insani sehat mein carbohydrates ka kirdar pecheeda (complex) hai. Yeh energy aur ghizaiyat (nutrients) ke liye zaroori hain, lekin hum kis qism ke aur kitne carbohydrates khate hain, is ka sehat par gehra asar parta hai. Sahi carbohydrates chun kar aur mutawazan (balanced) miqdar mein kha kar hum bimariyon ka khatra kam kar sakte hain. Neeche carbohydrates ke ahem jismani kaam (physiological functions) aur un ki kami ya zyadti ke khatre diye gaye hain.

items: Glucose jaisi saada sugars cells ke liye energy ka asal zariya hain. Yeh aasani se jazb (absorb) ho kar metabolism se energy deti hain; 1 g glucose taqreeban 15.6 kJ energy deta hai. Zaid (excess) glucose jigar aur muscles mein glycogen ban kar jama hota hai. Khoon mein glucose aam taur par 70-110 mg/dL hota hai aur din mein thora upar neeche hota rehta hai. Is ko insulin aur glucagon hormones qabu karte hain. Agar khoon ka glucose is had se barh jaye to diabetes ho sakti hai: yeh lambi (chronic) bimari hai jis mein pancreas kaafi insulin nahi banata, ya jism banaye gaye insulin ko theek se use nahi kar pata. Be-qabu diabetes se hyperglycemia (khoon mein zyada sugar) hota hai jo waqt ke saath jism ke nizam, khaas kar nerves (asaab) aur khoon ki nalon, ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai. Doosri taraf, bohat kam carbohydrate khane se thakan hoti hai aur jismani aur zehni karkardagi (performance) kam ho jati hai.

Fructose ka asal kaam metabolism ke dauran energy dena hai. Is ki zyada miqdar motapa (obesity) paida karti hai, yani jism mein charbi (fat) bohat jama ho jati hai. Refined (saaf ki hui) sugar wali khurak se diabetes, dil ki bimari aur kuch cancers ka khatra barh jata hai. Is ke ulat, complex carbohydrates aur fibre sehat ki hifazat karte hain aur in ke bohat fayde hain. Jab jism ke paas energy ke liye kaafi carbohydrates hon to woh inhi ko use karta hai, aur proteins ya fats ko eendhan (fuel) ke liye nahi torta.

blocks.title: Insulin aur glycogen
blocks.text: Insulin pancreas mein banne wala protein hormone hai. Is ki kami, ya jism ka ise theek se use na kar pana, diabetes mellitus ka sabab banta hai (topic 27.2.2 bhi dekhein). Jism zaid glucose ko glycogen ki shakal mein jama karta hai, isi liye jaanwar aur insaan lambi muscular activity ke liye glycogen ke zakheere rakhte hain.

blocks.alt: Fructose ki seedhi banawat: oopar CH2OH, phir C=O, phir HO-C-H, H-C-OH, H-C-OH, aur neeche CH2OH.
blocks.caption: Quick Check 27.1: Fructose ki seedhi banawat (Quick Check 27.1 mein chhapi banawat ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: a) Fructose ki seedhi (linear) banawat oopar di gayi hai. (i) Ise ring (cyclic) shakal mein kaise badlenge? (ii) Kya fructose paani mein ghulta hai? Wajah batayein. (iii) Khalis (pure) halat mein fructose ki physical state kya hogi?
blocks.explanation: (i) C5 ka OH C2 ke C=O carbon se jurta hai aur oxygen atom wala paanch kone ka ring (furanose) banta hai; C2 par naya OH ban jata hai. (ii) Haan, ghulta hai: is ke bohat se –OH groups paani ke molecules se hydrogen bonds banate hain. (iii) Thos (solid): –OH groups molecules ke darmiyan bohat hydrogen bonds banate hain jo unhein mazbooti se jore rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt: b) Glycosidic linkage kya hai? Fructose aur glucose ke darmiyan yeh kaise banti hai?
blocks.explanation: Do sugar units ke darmiyan C–O–C jor glycosidic linkage hai. Yeh condensation se banti hai: glucose ke C1 ka –OH aur fructose ke C2 ka –OH mil kar paani ka aik molecule chhorte hain, aur dono sugars aik oxygen atom ke zariye jur kar sucrose bana deti hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Carbohydrates ke koi do kaam batayein aur unhein un ki molecular banawat se jorein.
blocks.explanation: Energy dena: glucose chhota aur paani mein ghulne wala molecule hai, is liye khoon mein aasani se safar karta aur jaldi oxidise ho kar energy deta hai. Energy jama karna: starch aur glycogen bare, shaakhon wale aur paani mein na ghulne wale hain, is liye bohat sa glucose kam jagah mein jama kar lete hain. (Dhaancha: cellulose ki seedhi zanjeerein hydrogen bonds se jur kar mazboot fibre banati hain.)

items: Glucose cells ka asal eendhan hai (taqreeban 15.6 kJ fi gram); zaid glucose glycogen ban kar jama hota hai.
Khoon ka glucose 70-110 mg/dL, insulin aur glucagon qabu karte hain; had se zyada ho to diabetes.
Refined sugar aur zyada fructose bimariyon ka khatra barhate hain; complex carbohydrates aur fibre hifazat karte hain.
